# Three splits: the cost, the GST separated out, and the card.
# `Expenses:Supplies:USD` +100.00, `Liabilities:Tax:GST USD` +13.00 and
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD` −113.00.
#
# The bookkeeper split the tax at payment time, which somebody claiming the
# credit may well do. The bill that follows books the same two accounts, so
# both splits are duplicates of its own lines and moving only one of them
# would leave the other counted twice.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction of three splits, none in a
# lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:GST USD
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-18 * "Paid the supplier, tax split out"
	guid: "ccddeeff00112233445566778899aabb"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "ddeeff00112233445566778899aabbcc"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Tax:GST USD 13.00 USD
		guid: "eeff00112233445566778899aabbccdd"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -113.00 USD
		guid: "ff00112233445566778899aabbccddee"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
